description:
You are working in Odoo CRM. Create a new customer (company contact) with the following details:
- Company Name: 'Meridian Financial Group'
- Email: 'info@meridianfinancial.com'
- Phone: '+1 (212) 555-0847'
- Type: Company (not individual)
- City: 'New York'

Navigate to the Contacts module, create a new contact of type Company, fill in all the fields listed above, and save the record. Make sure to set the contact as a 'Company' type (not an individual).
